programme.title: The Curse Of the King Tut
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, the great Child King Tutankhamen ruled. Few know the details of his life no one knows the secrets of his death. But all is about to change. In 1922 Cairo, free-spirited archaeologist Danny Fremont is certain that if found, King Tut's Emerald Tablet would hold the ultimate power to control the world. But unfortunately, the only person who believes Fremont is his ruthless archaeologist nemesis Morgan Sinclair, a member of a secret society who wants the tablet to harness unspeakable evil on the world and will stop at nothing to get it and then extend their world domination. But with the help of a crackerjack team adventurers that includes the doubting egyptologist Dr. Azelia Barakat, Fremont ventures through the Valley of the Kings, toward Tut's tomb, near the portal to the underworld, and getting closer to the truth behind a mystery that will change the world forever or end it.

programme.title: Annie's Point
programme.desc: Richard Eason is flat-out filling his late father's shoes as CEO of an east Coast real estate developing company, so he can't spend nearly as much time with mother Annie and daughter Ella as they would like. Annie is dead-set on visiting a place in California where she and her late husband hoped to build their dream house and convinces Ella, who wants to drop out of school and aspires a singing career, to drive along. Ill-prepared but tempestuously stubborn, they embark on an adventurous road trip, where Ella meets hunky waiter Scott Tardy. Learning Annie needs surgery soon, Richard gives chase.

programme.title: Dinotopia
programme.desc: Based loosely on the novels by James Gurney, Dinotopia is a fantasy adventure series following two young brothers who wash up on the shore of the titular island, a magical lost paradise where humans and dinosaurs live together. Karl and David Scott are half-brothers enjoying a flight with their father on his private aircraft when tragedy strikes and the plane crashes to the ground. When they wash up on land, their adventure begins, learning about this hidden civilisation and begin to adjust to their surroundings. The three-episode show aired in 2002, starring Wentworth Miller, Tyron Leitso, and David Thewlis.

When his winning of a high-profile case thrusts him into the limelight, he decides to move his wife and their two kids out of their mixed lower-middle-class town and into the posh enclave of Greenwich, Connecticut.

programme.title: Killer Safari
programme.desc: Lions kill four buffaloes in a stampede, while in another drying river a buffalo fights off five of the big cats. As the dry winter looms, heading out on a game drive means checking in at all the remaining waterholes. This is where the action plays out. Each event is unpacked and explained, offering a highly charged, emotional and informative ride.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters
programme.desc: Large carnivores such as leopards, lions and hyenas are in constant competition for their next meal for their pack in Zambia's Luangwa Valley. Following the lives of the wise old leopard Kamuti who rained over the prime territory in the Luangwa Valley for 10 years, a six-week-old lion cub and a clan of spotted hyenas, this documentary series allows audiences to see these magnificent animals like never before. With up-close imagery of animals existing within Luangwa Valley and their life in the wild, feel a part of the pack with Africa's Hunters.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin leaves the Australian mainland to discover which of the island-dwelling animals is truly built to survive. First up, he meets the enigmatic green turtle on the Wellesley Islands. Next, he is on K'Gari (Fraser Island), where he tracks down a pack of the notorious dingoes. Finally, he encounters the formidable and aptly named death adder snake.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin dares into the Australian savannah to find the species most built to survive. First is Australia's largest bird of prey, the majestic but intimidating wedge-tailed eagle. Next, Phil tracks down one of the world's deadliest snakes, the coastal taipan. Finally, Phil faces the uniquely Australian frill-necked lizard, a reptile with fascinating defense mechanisms.

programme.title: Untamed Philippines
programme.desc: We start on the tiny island of Batan, meeting a unique viper and a ubiquitous but also giant, land crab. Luzon is the main island of the Philippines. We drop in to Mindoro to see the most endangered large mammal in the Philippines, the tamaraw.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: Rule of the kingdom is reserved only for the strong. Five heroes, each with a unique power, head up rival families struggling for power, clawing their way to the top. The winners are rewarded with the richest hunting grounds in the kingdom, but the fate of the losers is brutal - exile or death. Fighting to survive, killing to succeed - nothing will stop them trying to reign supreme over the Savage Kingdom.

programme.title: Katavi - Africa's Fallen Paradise
programme.desc: Katavi National Park spans over 3,000 square miles of western Tanzania. Lions, hippos and crocodiles live in harmony, until an unusual climatic cycle turns the normal dry season into an extreme drought. Lion cubs face mortal danger from a rogue male lion intent on a takeover, hippos fight viciously for dwindling river territory, and even the crocodiles struggle to survive until the rains arrive.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: Rule of the kingdom is reserved only for the strong. Five heroes, each with a unique power, head up rival families struggling for power, clawing their way to the top. The winners are rewarded with the richest hunting grounds in the kingdom, but the fate of the losers is brutal - exile or death. programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: She haunts the trees and hills in the heart of the realm. She is solitary, silent and virtually invisible. Saba the leopard is a killer without rival. Saba is the most spectacular and resourceful hunter the Savage Kingdom has seen. Her stronghold, Leopard Rock, sits at the heart of this brutal realm it is a place where she can vanish into the shadows and avoid running into her rivals lions, hyenas and wild dogs. There is no question that Saba the leopard can take care of herself, but her strength and resilience will be cruelly tested when she tries to bring two cubs into the realm where only she can protect and feed them in the midst of the cauldron of warring predators. The ordeal will tear at her heart.

programme.title: Savage Kingdom
programme.desc: The sparse African Savannah can be a fearsome place for both herds of powerful prey and the lurking predators who hunt them down. In this captivating documentary series from National Geographic, the relationship between predator and prey is closely examined, exploring the fight for survival for both sets of animals. These herds are full of powerful or agile animals, making the job of a predator to feed itself and its family a troublesome task. But the African predators are ruthless and proficient hunters, and if a herd is infiltrated, or a straggling member is targeted, they will struggle to evade these savage carnivores.

programme.title: Katavi - Africa's Fallen Paradise
programme.desc: Katavi National Park spans over 3,000 square miles of western Tanzania. Lions, hippos and crocodiles live in harmony, until an unusual climatic cycle turns the normal dry season into an extreme drought. Lion cubs face mortal danger from a rogue male lion intent on a takeover, hippos fight viciously for dwindling river territory, and even the crocodiles struggle to survive until the rains arrive.

programme.title: Katavi - Africa's Fallen Paradise
programme.desc: Katavi is in the grips of extraordinary drought. A new litter of lion cubs is born into tough conditions, vulnerable to the attack of a rogue male, intent on taking over the pride. Water levels drop by the day, pushing two hippos to overthrow an alpha bull. Distant storms bring not rain but fire sparked by lightning. In the crushing heat, life desperately struggles to hold out for rain.

programme.title: Katavi - Africa's Fallen Paradise
programme.desc: Katavi's wetlands are unrecognizable in a prolonged drought, reduced to fetid, overcrowded mud wallows. At last, rains resurrect the river, inch by inch. Tensions wash away as hippos and crocodiles rejoice in the return of deep water … but flooding traps lion cubs in a precarious position. Normality will finally return to Katavi, but amidst global climate change, for how long?

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin journeys down Australia's rivers to find which riparian animal is most built to survive. His first encounter is with the duck-billed platypus, a peculiar and adorable monotreme, or egg-laying mammal. Phil then gets a grip on the ultra-slimy long-finned eel and learns of its extraordinary reproductive habits before finally catching a river-dwelling bull shark.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin wanders into Australia's woodlands to find the species most adapted for survival. Phil first encounters the yellow-bellied glider, an intrepid marsupial with a built-in wingsuit. Next is one of Australia's most abundant but deadly reptiles, the eastern brown snake. Last but certainly not least, Phil finds the iconic, cuddly and oh-so-sleepy koala.

programme.title: Winter's Hidden Wonders
programme.desc: Winter is the most punishing of seasons, a time of year when many animals seek shelter in order to hibernate, but others must face the harshness of their environment. This documentary series showcases the ruthless beauty of this icy season, revealing the animals who thrive in their freezing conditions and the animals who simply fight for survival. When the season finally passes spring is reborn, and it is a celebration for those who managed to survive unscathed.

programme.title: Secrets of the Octopus
programme.desc: Octopuses break all the rules on animal intelligence. Born into the world as orphans, they are self-taught masterminds; capable of solving complex problems, strategizing, even planning for the future. Extraordinary superpowers that are the secret to their success.

programme.title: Wonders of the Ocean

programme.title: America's Wild Spaces
programme.desc: This show explores the unbridled natural beauty of America's national parks and highlights some of the most awe-inspiring scenery on the planet. Travelling beyond the more conventional tourist hot-spots, the viewer is transported to the hidden wonders of America's wild spaces. Episodes include joining a scientific exploration of the 277 mile long Grand Canyon, studying its geological history, exploring the microscopic colonies of vegetation and examining its unique creatures; journeying through the Everglades, a 1.5 million acre home to strange creatures, carnivorous plants, amphibious birds and fish that can breathe air; and navigating across the northwest archipelago of Hawaii following a team of diving scientists as they inspect the unique aquaeous flora and fauna.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Polar Bears
programme.desc: Legendary polar bear tracker and veteran polar bear guide Dennis Compayre presents his exclusive documentary. Have a look at the world of a polar bear mom and her newborn cubs as they leave their den for the first time, and how mother teaches her babies to survive. Spring birthing season is considered the most dangerous for humans to observe bears. That is why it has been largely undocumented until now.

programme.title: Return of the Predators
programme.desc: After 30 years of war and destruction, Gorongosa National Park in Mozambique has undergone a remarkable restoration. Herbivores once again bound across the plains, but hunters have been slower to return, leaving the park out of balance...until now!

programme.title: Kingdom of the White Wolf
programme.desc: Join Ronan Donovan, a National Geographic Explorer and photographer, as he takes the viewer on a unique adventure to track down the hard-to-find Arctic wolf. The series follows the year-long travails of a family of Arctic wolves on Ellesmere Island, from the first breaking light after the long winter, through the life-bringing springtime, the fattening summer months and the preparations of autumn. Each episode deals with different obstacles that the wolves face and have to overcome and, along the way, we the various characters and personalities of the animal family are revealed. The show makes good use of intimate footage to make the viewer feel that they are actually there, observing the creatures up close.

programme.title: Killer Animal Tactics

The name of the game is kill or be killed!

programme.title: World's Deadliest Killers
programme.desc: In the darkest corners of the world, deadly predators watch and wait for their next, unsuspecting prey. Armed with special nighttime powers, including extra-strength night vision and hypersensitive hearing, these creatures are anatomically designed to succeed in the dark.

programme.title: America's Wild Spaces
programme.desc: This show explores the unbridled natural beauty of America's national parks and highlights some of the most awe-inspiring scenery on the planet. Travelling beyond the more conventional tourist hot-spots, the viewer is transported to the hidden wonders of America's wild spaces. Episodes include joining a scientific exploration of the 277 mile long Grand Canyon, studying its geological history, exploring the microscopic colonies of vegetation and examining its unique creatures; journeying through the Everglades, a 1.5 million acre home to strange creatures, carnivorous plants, amphibious birds and fish that can breathe air; and navigating across the northwest archipelago of Hawaii following a team of diving scientists as they inspect the unique aquaeous flora and fauna.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: Kamp Koral
programme.desc: A prequel to SpongeBob SquarePants, featuring the beloved characters as children, spending their summertime at Camp Coral having fun doing typical camp activities like building campfires, catching jellyfish, and swimming in Lake Yuckymuck, causing a bit of trouble and chaos on the side. SpongeBob SquarePants is a ten-year-old with a red cap, goofy and friendly as he's always been. Let's not forget SpongeBob's friends, Patrick, Sandy, and Squidward, who's a bit older than the others and works as a junior counselor. All other characters such as Mr. Krabs, Mrs. Puff, SpongeBob's nemesis Plankton, and Karen are a part of this adventure as well.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

Timmy's greenness in making his wishes causes troubles and he has to "unwish" them together with his fairy godparents to avoid possible disasters. programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: "Pet's Peeved: The notorious Vesuvius Twins have adopted Skipper and King Julien and brought the animal's home to their luxury apartment. Not to spoil and pamper - but to fight each other over shiny baubles! The rest of the penguins and lemurs attempt a rescue but are captured themselves and made to perform in a painful "circus" the twins put together. The tables are going to need to be turned to get this circus out of town. Byte-Sized: Kowalski has another breakthrough invention, tiny robots that group together and not only fix broken tools and appliances, but run them as well. The penguins can just sit back and let the "Nanites" take care of all their chores! The problem is, the Nanites are programmed to protect the penguins at all costs, and ultimately seal the birds inside their lair. The only way to escape is to do battle with a giant, nasty, Nanite robot.".

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Private has an arch enemy in the form of Dale the snail. Why does this snail hate Private so much? It's because Private allegedly smashed the little guy, and keeps smashing him albeit accidentally. Even a public apology ends with Dale getting crushed. Sadly, Dale should never have been enemies with Private to begin with - it was a different penguin who did him wrong. // King Julien becomes enamored of a giant toilet the penguins have built. He wants to use it as his new throne, only the toilet is actually a stink bomb the penguins built to trap Dr. Blowhole. Julien accidently gets trapped, bound tightly to the bomb, so the penguins must try to stop it from detonating, all while going on a wild truck chase through New York. They end up in a New Jersey dump, and Skipper must show a sensitive side before all is lost.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po the Panda trains, battles, learns, teaches, stumbles, gabs and ""geeks out"" as the newest hero in the Valley of Peace. Now living in his permanent home at the Jade Palace with the rest of the Furious Five, Po will have to take on new responsibilities and face brand-new adversaries (not seen in the movies) in his continuing education as the Dragon Warrior...for being the Dragon Warrior is not a destination, it's a journey (unfortunately for Po, that journey is uphill).

programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.desc: "HALF-HOUR SUMMER VACATION SPECIAL The penguin's worst nightmare has come true. After a sailing trip gone wrong they wind up in the Hoboken Zoo. programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar

programme.title: La Liga. Madrido „Getafe“ - Ovjedo „Real“
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.desc: The English Football League Championship or the "EFL" as it is otherwise referred to, is the stepping stone from the wilderness of English football, to the riches associated with the promised land, that is the 'English Premier League'. In keeping with traditions of this club championship, we bring you first-hand, live coverage of developments for this division. Touted as one of the hardest leagues to manoeuvre out of, it was founded in 2004 and has truly delivered with its play-off system, offering a whole new dimension of entertainment, compared to other leagues out there. From "Sleeping Giants" such as Nottingham Forest & Sheffield Wednesday, to the jostling pack of Preston & Brentford, marquee match-ups every week will decide the final Championship standings, come the end of May.

programme.title: La rivolta delle ex
programme.desc: Matthew McConaughey e Jennifer Garner in una commedia romantica dal tocco soprannaturale. Connor Mead è un celebre fotografo che ha un enorme fascino sulle donne: nessuna riesce a resistergli, e lui da cinico playboy passa da un'avventura all'altra. Per lui non esistono relazioni stabili, tanto meno il matrimonio. E di questo cerca di convincere anche il fratello minore, che invece sta per sposarsi, ma i fantasmi delle sue numerose ex cominciano a perseguitarlo, mostrandogli quello che sarà il suo futuro. Nel cast, anche Michael Douglas.

programme.title: Proposta indecente
programme.desc: Demi Moore, Woody Harrelson e Robert Redford nell'indimenticabile pellicola firmata dal regista di "Nove settimane e mezzo" e "Attrazione fatale". Diana e David sono una coppia felicemente sposata ma in cattive acque dal punto di vista economico, tanto da tentare la fortuna fra i tavoli e le slot machine di Las Vegas. In loro soccorso arriva l'allettante proposta di un ricco miliardario: un milione di dollari in cambio di una sola notte d'amore con la donna. Dopo molti dubbi, Diana e David decidono di accettare l'offerta ma le conseguenze saranno devastanti...

programme.title: Cinquanta sfumature di rosso

Anastasia e Christian, finalmente sposi, credono di essersi lasciati alle spalle il torbido passato. L’armonia di coppia sembra di acciaio ma c’è qualcuno che è infastidito dalla loro felicità e nuovi squilibri si affacciano all’orizzonte mettendo a rischio il loro legame. Kim Basinger interpreta Elena, la socia in affari ed ex amante di Christian, oltre ad essere colei che lo ha introdotto nello sfaccettato universo delle perversioni sessuali.

Quando scopre di essere l'ebreo eletto da Dio rinuncia a tutti i suoi privilegi acquisiti, per liberare il suo popolo e condurlo verso la Terra Promessa: un racconto epico che si snoda tra i pericoli dell'attraversamento del Mar Rosso e l'ascesa al Sinai, con la consegna delle Tavole della Legge.

Giunti su un'isola verranno pero' attaccati da una nave americana rischiando di essere schiavizzati ancora. Seconda nomination agli Oscar per Anthony Hopkins nel ruolo di un Presidente degli Stati Uniti (qui interpreta John Q. Adams) dopo quella ottenuta per "Nixon".

programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio nell'ennesimo capolavoro di Clint Eastwood, che entra nel cuore della storia americana raccontando la chiacchierata vita di J. Edgar Hoover: leggendario capo dell'FBI per quasi 50 anni, dal 1924 al 1972, sotto ben otto presidenti degli Stati Uniti. Il ritratto pubblico e privato di un uomo, e della sua strenua lotta contro la criminalità e il mondo dei gangster. Un uomo, considerato il più potente d'America, che non si fermò davanti a nulla pur di proteggere il proprio Paese. Anche a costo di infrangere ogni regola, scritta e non.

programme.title: Mystic River
programme.desc: Oscar e Golden Globe a Sean Penn e Tim Robbins, in un capolavoro di Clint Eastwood. L'omicidio di una ragazza riporta alla luce un caso di pedofilia che coinvolse tre bambini di Boston.

programme.title: Di nuovo in gioco
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood, Amy Adams e Justin Timberlake in un film su padri e figli. Un anziano talent-scout del baseball ricuce il rapporto con la figlia mentre cerca un nuovo campione da lanciare.

programme.title: Potere assoluto
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood dirige e interpreta, al fianco di Gene Hackman, un thriller da antologia. Luther Whitney è un vero artista del furto, nessuna cassaforte o serratura può resistergli, ma ormai sta diventando anziano e ha deciso di ritirarsi dopo un ultimo colpo. Deve però fare i conti con un imprevisto perché la padrona della casa che Luther ha deciso di svaligiare non è partita con il marito, per intrattenersi con il suo amante che non è altri che il Presidente degli Stati Uniti. Quando la donna muore, la polizia prova a insabbiare il caso, ma per farlo occorre far tacere l'unico testimone. Eastwood e Hackman di nuovo uno contro l'altro, come ne "Gli spietati".

programme.title: Fuga da Alcatraz
programme.desc: Cult assoluto del cinema carcerario diretto da Don Siegel. Clint Eastwood è un detenuto in fuga dall'inespugnabile penitenziario di Alcatraz, amministrato da un sadico aguzzino.

programme.title: Questo o quello: Speciale
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si raccontano le migliori pellicole del leggendario Clint Eastwood disponibili da sabato 13 a venerdì 19 settembre su Sky Cinema Collection.

programme.title: Million Dollar Baby
programme.desc: 4 Oscar al capolavoro diretto e interpretato da Clint Eastwood con Hilary Swank e Morgan Freeman. Un anziano e burbero allenatore di boxe trasforma una tenace ragazza in una campionessa.

programme.title: Ore 15:17 - Attacco al treno
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood affronta la piaga del terrorismo dirigendo un dramma tratto da una storia vera, interpretata dagli eroi che l'hanno realmente vissuta. Spencer Stone, Alek Skarlatos e Anthony Sadler sono tre ragazzi di Sacramento, amici di lunga data, che stanno passando le vacanze in giro per l'Europa. E il 21 agosto del 2015 si trovano a bordo del treno Thalys 9364 diretto da Amsterdam a Parigi. Il treno, con a bordo circa 500 passeggeri, è anche l'obiettivo dell'Isis, ma saranno proprio Spencer, Alek e Anthony a sventare l'attentato, trasformandosi da persone comuni a eroi.

programme.title: Gran Torino
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood firma l'ennesimo capolavoro della sua folgorante carriera. Walt Kowalski è un veterano della guerra che ha appena perso la moglie. Le uniche sue passioni sono il fedele cane e la sua auto: una Ford Gran Torino che tiene con cura maniacale. Non sopporta i suoi vicini asiatici, men che meno il giovane Thao che ha provato a rubargli la sua amata macchina per esser ammesso in una gang. Ma sarà lui a salvare il ragazzo dal branco, divenendo il suo mentore. David di Donatello e Nastro d’argento come miglior film straniero.

programme.title: Sully
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood dirige un intenso biopic con Tom Hanks. Dopo aver salvato i passeggeri del suo aereo con una coraggiosa manovra, nel 2009 il capitano Sullenberger fu messo sotto accusa.

programme.title: Giurato numero 2
programme.desc: Nicholas Hoult e Toni Collette in un legal-thriller di Clint Eastwood. Durante un processo per omicidio, uno dei giurati scopre di essere l'involontario colpevole del delitto. Sconvolto dal senso di colpa, cerca di scagionare l'imputato senza rivelare la propria responsabilità.

programme.title: Tappo - Cucciolo in un mare di guai
programme.desc: Divertente film d’animazione di Kevin Johnson. Alla morte della padrona, il viziato cagnolino Tappo si ritrova da solo come un randagio, ma la nuova amica Zoe è pronta ad aiutarlo.

programme.title: Inkheart - La leggenda di Cuore d'inchiostro
programme.desc: Brendan Fraser ed Helen Mirren in un'entusiasmante avventura fantasy. Una ragazzina di 12 anni e suo padre hanno la straordinaria capacità di rendere umani i personaggi dei romanzi. Un potere magico che ha un solo effetto collaterale, tutt'altro che secondario: per ogni personaggio che prende vita, una persona reale sparisce in un libro. Proprio come accaduto 10 anni prima a Resa, moglie di Mortimer Folchart detto Mo e madre della piccola Maggie. Che ora, dopo aver trovato "Inkheart", libro fantasy sul Medioevo, forse potrà tornare finalmente a casa. Tratto da un romanzo di Cornelia Funke.

programme.title: Scarpette rosse e i 7 nani
programme.desc: La fiaba di Biancaneve in una grottesca rivisitazione animata da Jin Kim. Per rompere la magia che li ha tramutati in nani, sette principi devono farsi baciare da una principessa.

programme.title: Cicogne in missione
programme.desc: Pellicola d'animazione dai creatori di "The Lego Movie". Le cicogne consegnano ormai i bebe' online, ma un imprevisto obbliga il loro miglior corriere a una corsa contro il tempo.

programme.title: Lassie torna a casa
programme.desc: Avventuroso reboot del film datato 1943, che riporta sullo schermo il cane più famoso del cinema. Finito in una famiglia che non esita a maltrattarlo, Lassie riesce a scappare e affronta molti pericoli pur di ricongiungersi con il suo affezionato padrone Florian.

programme.title: Mia e il leone bianco
programme.desc: Daniah De Villiers e Mélanie Laurent nella toccante storia di un legame impossibile. Trasferitasi in Sudafrica con i genitori, Mia stringe amicizia con un cucciolo di leone bianco.

programme.title: Balto e Togo - La leggenda
programme.desc: Scritto, diretto e interpretato da Brian Presley, film d’avventura ispirato a una storia vera. Alaska, 1925. Nella cittadina di Nome la difterite colpisce i bambini. Con i cani da slitta Balto e Togo, Leonhard e altri uomini del villaggio partono alla ricerca del siero curativo.

programme.title: Mrs. Doubtfire - Mammo per sempre
programme.desc: Uno dei personaggi piu' riusciti del grande Robin Williams, che scatena la sua comicita' in abiti femminili. Per stare vicino ai suoi tre figli dei quali ha perso l'affidamento dopo il divorzio, Daniel si traveste da governante e si fa assumere dall'ex moglie, interpretata dal premio Oscar Sally Field, che gli impedisce di vederli. Irriconoscibile, diventa cosi' Mrs. Doubtfire e puo' occuparsi dei tre ragazzi che si affezionano a 'lei'. Oscar per il miglior trucco. Dal regista di "Mamma ho perso l'aereo", nel cast anche Pierce Brosnan.

programme.title: Belle & Sebastien - L'avventura continua
programme.desc: Secondo film tratto dai romanzi di Cecile Aubry. Sebastien non crede alla morte di Angelina e parte alla sua ricerca insieme a Belle. Durante il viaggio, una scoperta cambiera' la sua vita.

programme.title: Caterina va in città
programme.desc: Commedia di Paolo Virzì con Margherita Buy e Sergio Castellitto. Giunta a Roma dalla provincia con i genitori, una timida tredicenne s'immerge nelle contraddizioni sociali della capitale.

programme.desc: Dwayne Johnson, Karen Gillan e Jack Black nel sequel campione d’incassi del film con Robin Williams. Quattro liceali trovano una console e vengono catapultati all'interno di un videogame.

programme.desc: Robert De Niro, Uma Thurman e Christopher Walken nella commedia Sky Original per tutta la famiglia. Un nonno occupa la stanza del nipote, che fara' di tutto per riconquistare il suo spazio.

programme.desc: Action con Samuel L. Jackson, Hailee Steinfeld e Jessica Alba. Addestrata fin da piccola ad uccidere, Megan sogna un'esistenza normale. Una nuova missione le darà modo di rifarsi una vita.

programme.title: 10 Lives - Un Gatto Fortunato
programme.desc: Divertente animazione targata Sky Original. Dopo aver perso la sua nona e ultima vita, al pigro micio Becket non resta che supplicare un'ultima possibilità al guardiano del Paradiso.

programme.desc: Avventura nella preistoria firmata DreamWorks. Alla ricerca di un rifugio dopo un terremoto, il cavernicolo Grug e la sua famiglia scoprono un mondo popolato da fantastiche creature.

programme.title: I Croods 2 - Una nuova era
programme.desc: Seconda avventura animata per gli sprizzanti cavernicoli. Dopo aver accolto il giovane Guy, i Croods vanno in cerca di un luogo chiamato ‘casa’. Una volta trovato, dovranno fare i conti con i suoi abitanti, l'evoluto clan dei Superior, finché una nuova minaccia non porterà le due famiglie a unire le loro forze.

programme.title: Jumanji - The Next Level
programme.desc: Dwayne Johnson, Kevin Hart, Jack Black e Karen Gillan tornano in azione all’interno del videogame. La nostalgia per l’avventura vissuta convince Spencer a rituffarsi dentro Jumanji. I suoi amici lo inseguono per riportarlo indietro, sfidando nuovi pericoli e territori inesplorati.

programme.desc: James McAvoy e Mackenzie Davis in un thriller psicologico, remake dell'omonimo film danese. Una coppia americana accetta l'invito di due ambigui coniugi inglesi conosciuti in vacanza. Durante un inquietante weekend in campagna, i padroni di casa rivelano il loro vero volto.

programme.title: On the Line
programme.desc: Thriller Sky Original al cardiopalma con Mel Gibson. Un conduttore radiofonico riceve in diretta la chiamata di un ascoltatore anonimo che minaccia di uccidere lui e la sua famiglia.

programme.title: Every Breath You Take - Senza respiro
programme.desc: Thriller Sky Original con Casey Affleck, Sam Claflin e Michelle Monaghan. Il suicidio di una paziente compromette l'equilibrio familiare di uno psichiatra.

programme.title: MaXXXine
programme.desc: Capitolo finale della trilogia horror di Ti West con Mia Goth. 1985: Maxine Minx è un'attrice hard che sogna di sfondare a Hollywood. Il ruolo in un ambizioso film horror può essere la svolta, ma una figura misteriosa emerge dal suo passato, mentre un serial killer insanguina la città.

programme.title: I delitti del BarLume 11 - Speciale
programme.desc: I registi insieme ai protagonisti del BarLume danno voce a un divertente racconto del dietro le quinte delle nuove storie de "I delitti del BarLume".

programme.title: Abigail
programme.desc: Un gruppo di criminali rapisce la figlia dodicenne di un misterioso riccastro. La ragazzina si rivela essere una feroce vampira, pronta a difendersi con le unghie e soprattutto con i denti dai suoi malcapitati aguzzini.

programme.title: L'inferno di cristallo
programme.desc: 3 Oscar e 2 Golden Globe al film precursore del genere catastrofico con Paul Newman e Steve McQueen. L'inaugurazione di un grattacielo a San Francisco rischia di trasformarsi in tragedia.

programme.title: La legge della notte
programme.desc: Ben Affleck dirige e interpreta un noir ambientato negli anni del proibizionismo. Un veterano della Prima guerra mondiale ripudia gli insegnamenti del padre diventando un criminale.

programme.title: Black Mass - L'ultimo gangster
programme.desc: La storia vera del criminale James 'Whitey' Bulger con Johnny Depp e Benedict Cumberbatch. Anni '70: un gangster irlandese collabora con l'Fbi per incastrare i rivali della mafia italiana.

programme.title: Manhattan Nocturne
programme.desc: Palpitante thriller con Adrien Brody. Un giornalista newyorkese sprofonda in un vortice di pericoli mortali quando un'attraente sconosciuta lo convince ad indagare sull'omicidio del marito.

programme.title: Detective Marlowe
programme.desc: Thriller Sky Original di Neil Jordan con Liam Neeson, Diane Kruger e Jessica Lange. Hollywood, anni 30: il detective Marlowe e' incaricato di ritrovare l'ex amante di un'ereditiera.

programme.title: Il caso Thomas Crawford
programme.desc: Thriller con Anthony Hopkins e Ryan Gosling. Un uomo si auto-accusa dell'omicidio della moglie, che lo tradiva con un poliziotto. Ma il suo è un piano diabolico...

programme.title: Voglia di potere
programme.desc: Jason Robards e Forest Whitaker in un serrato thriller politico TV. Stati Uniti: un colonnello deve impedire un golpe organizzato da un insospettabile e pluridecorato generale.

programme.title: The Hateful Eight
programme.desc: Western di Quentin Tarantino con un supercast. In un rifugio di montagna, otto sconosciuti si scontrano fra minacce, inganni e pallottole. Oscar alle musiche di Ennio Morricone.

programme.title: Vetro
programme.desc: Thriller voyeuristico con Carolina Sala, opera prima di Domenico Croce. Una ragazza che vive isolata nella sua stanza si convince che nel palazzo di fronte si sia consumato un crimine.

programme.title: State a casa
programme.desc: Roan Johnson dirige una dark comedy dal ritmo incalzante con Tommaso Ragno e Dario Aita. Roma: costretti dalla pandemia da Covid-19 a una convivenza forzata nell’appartamento che condividono, quattro ragazzi in difficoltà economica saranno travolti da una nefasta spirale di eventi.

programme.title: Smile 2
programme.desc: Parker Finn dirige Naomi Scott nel perturbante secondo capitolo della saga horror. Una giovane popstar, perseguitata da esasperanti allucinazioni e divorata dalla paura, deve trovare una via di fuga da una terrificante entità maligna con il potere di spostarsi di persona in persona.

programme.title: Prima ti sposo, poi ti rovino
programme.desc: George Clooney e Catherine Zeta-Jones in un'esplosiva commedia romantica dei fratelli Coen. Una donna, che colleziona mariti per denaro, si vendica sposando l'avvocato che l'ha incastrata.

programme.title: Pane e burlesque
programme.desc: Laura Chiatti e Sabrina Impacciatore in una piccante commedia a tinte rosa. Un paesino del Sud, in crisi e affollato di cassaintegrati dopo la chiusura della fabbrica di ceramiche, viene scosso dall'arrivo di Mimi' la Petite e della sua compagnia di burlesque. Il loro destino si intreccia con quello di Matilde e Teresa, in cerca di un'occasione perche' anche la merceria dove lavorano accusa le difficolta' economiche. Mimi', pero', e' arrivata in citta' anche per un altro motivo: e' infatti la figlia del proprietario della fabbrica e deve vendere le proprieta' di famiglia.

programme.title: Shall We Dance?
programme.desc: Richard Gere e Jennifer Lopez per una commedia romantica a passo di danza. Lui e' un avvocato di successo con una bella famiglia ma si sente infelice. Lei e' l'insegnante di ballo che potrebbe aiutarlo a colmare il suo vuoto interiore.

programme.title: Mamma mia! - Ci risiamo
programme.desc: Tornano Amanda Seyfried, Meryl Streep e Colin Firth nel sequel del musical scandito dalle canzoni degli Abba. Sull'isola greca di Kalokairi, Sophie e' alle prese con la ristrutturazione dell'hotel di famiglia e soffre per la mancanza di Sky, partito per uno stage di sei settimane negli Stati Uniti. Il ragazzo vorrebbe che lei lo raggiungesse, ma Sophie non vuole lasciare l'isola per non mancare di rispetto alla madre, Donna, scomparsa un anno prima. Alla vigilia dell'inaugurazione dell'albergo, tuttavia, un violento uragano si abbatte su Kalokairi.

programme.title: Via col vento
programme.desc: 8 Oscar al kolossal di Victor Fleming con Clark Gable e Vivian Leigh. Le tormentate vicende di un affascinante avventuriero e di una fiera ereditiera nell'America della Guerra Civile.

programme.title: Quel mostro di suocera
programme.desc: Jennifer Lopez e Jane Fonda in una brillante commedia a tinte rosa. Una ragazza sta per sposare l'uomo ideale, ma l'invadente futura suocera farà di tutto per renderle la vita un inferno.

programme.title: We Live In Time - Tutto il tempo che abbiamo
programme.desc: Florence Pugh e Andrew Garfield sono i protagonisti di una toccante storia d’amore. Dopo un incidente, Tobias e Almut vivranno un'intensa relazione tra momenti di felicità e dolore.

programme.title: Beata te
programme.desc: Serena Rossi e Fabio Balsamo nella commedia Sky Original di Paola Randi. Marta riceve la visita dell'Arcangelo che le annuncia l'arrivo di un figlio. Basteranno 14 giorni per decidere?

programme.title: Ex
programme.desc: Fausto Brizzi dirige una commedia corale con Claudio Bisio, Nancy Brilli e Alessandro Gassmann. La ricomparsa degli ex mette in crisi il rapporto di sei coppie.

programme.title: Pearl Harbor
programme.desc: Michael Bay dirige Ben Affleck e Kate Beckinsale in un kolossal sentimentale premiato con un Oscar. 1941: prima dell'attacco giapponese, due piloti si innamorano della stessa donna.

programme.title: Una lunga domenica di passioni
programme.desc: Jean Pierre Jeunet dirige Audrey Tautou in un toccante dramma sentimentale. Una donna affronta gli orrori della Prima Guerra Mondiale per cercare il fidanzato, dato per disperso.

programme.title: Questo o quello - Fast & Furious - Ep. 226 - Questo O Quello - Fast & Furious
programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si confrontano sui film della spettacolare saga action Fast & Furious, da sabato 20 a venerdì 26 settembre su Sky Cinema Collection.

programme.title: Il dottor Zivago
programme.desc: 5 Oscar alla storia d'amore fra Omar Sharif e Julie Christie, dal romanzo di Pasternak. Sullo sfondo della Rivoluzione russa, un medico si innamora perdutamente di un'infermiera.

programme.title: Quel mostro di suocera

programme.title: Sex And The City
programme.desc: Primo film tratto dalla leggendaria serie. Mentre Carrie ha deciso di sposare Mr. Big, Samantha si gode la California, Charlotte adotta una bimba e Miranda e' in crisi con Steve.

programme.title: Moglie e marito
programme.desc: Fioccano gli equivoci nella commedia con Pierfrancesco Favino e Kasia Smutniak. Andrea e' un affermato neurochirurgo, sua moglie Sofia una conduttrice televisiva: sono sposati, hanno due figli ma il loro rapporto attraversa una crisi nera. Non riescono proprio a capire le reciproche difficolta', almeno fino a quando non ci mette lo zampino il destino: un esperimento scientifico riuscito male scaraventa l'uno nel corpo dell'altra innescando una serie di momenti imbarazzanti ma molto divertenti. Andrea e Sofia scopriranno nella pratica cosa significa vivere nei panni del partner.

Per uscire dal blocco creativo, uno scrittore si rivolge a un’eccentrica medium, che rievoca lo spirito dell’ex moglie. Questa presenza susciterà le gelosie dell’attuale consorte.

programme.desc: Emozionante film Sky Original di e con Edoardo Leo affiancato da Marta Nieto, Claudia Gerini e Stefano Fresi. Due coppie affrontano il momento più delicato della loro lunga vita insieme.

programme.desc: Julia Roberts e Hugh Grant nell'amabile commedia romantica di Roger Michell scritta da Richard Curtis. Un timido librario londinese incontra una diva di Hollywood... e sboccia l'amore.

programme.desc: Dal regista de "La vita di Adele", un sensuale film di formazione. Un aspirante sceneggiatore torna nella città d'origine per l'estate dove trova vecchi amori e nuovi amici.

programme.desc: Un cast di star hollywoodiane per una commedia sul mistero dell'amore. A ridosso di San Valentino, si intrecciano le storie di coppie innamorate e di single in cerca dell'anima gemella. Persone che si incontrano e si perdono di vista nei modi piu' imprevedibili. Coppie che si sfasciano, altre che si formano, qualcuno incontrera' l'amore della sua vita, qualcun altro vivra' un'avventura fugace, tutto dall'alba al tramonto, a Los Angeles. Dal regista di "Pretty Woman", il film negli Stati Uniti e' uscito nel giorno di San Valentino, incassando al debutto 57 milioni di dollari.

Diana e David sono una coppia felicemente sposata ma in cattive acque dal punto di vista economico, tanto da tentare la fortuna fra i tavoli e le slot machine di Las Vegas. In loro soccorso arriva l'allettante proposta di un ricco miliardario: un milione di dollari in cambio di una sola notte d'amore con la donna. Dopo molti dubbi, Diana e David decidono di accettare l'offerta ma le conseguenze saranno devastanti...

programme.desc: Commedia di e con Sergio Castellitto, Berenice Bejo e Matilda De Angelis. Parigi: la vita monotona del proprietario di una libreria riceve una scossa grazie a un'esuberante attrice.

programme.desc: Dal regista di "Famiglia all'improvviso", un'incantevole commedia romantica con Francois Civil e Joséphine Japy. Un famoso romanziere si risveglia in un mondo parallelo e capisce di dover riconquistare Olivia, la donna che ama e che ha già sposato nella sua vita originale.

programme.title: Lei mi parla ancora
programme.desc: Pupi Avati dirige Renato Pozzetto e un grande cast nel film Sky Original ispirato al romanzo di Giuseppe Sgarbi. Dopo la morte della moglie, un uomo ripercorre la storia d'amore di una vita.

programme.title: Hit Man - Killer per caso
programme.desc: Brillante commedia di Richard Linklater con Glen Powell. Un docente collabora con la polizia fingendosi un sicario, ma un giorno infrange il protocollo.

programme.desc: Due nomination agli Oscar per un raffinato film sentimentale. Due amici d’infanzia si separano quando la famiglia di lei emigra dalla Corea del Sud. Dopo 2 decenni si ritrovano a New York.

programme.desc: Miglior regia a Cannes alla pellicola romantica di Tran Anh Hung con Juliette Binoche. Francia, 1885: il sodalizio tra la cuoca Eugenie e il gastronomo Dodin da' vita a piatti stellati.

programme.desc: Francesco Castelnuovo e Gianni Canova si confrontano sui film della spettacolare saga action Fast & Furious, da sabato 20 a venerdì 26 settembre su Sky Cinema Collection.

programme.title: Ogni cosa è illuminata
programme.desc: Esordio alla regia di Liev Schreiber nel cult on the road con Elijah Wood. Un giovane americano intraprende un viaggio in Ucraina alla ricerca della donna che salvò suo nonno dai nazisti.

programme.desc: Dramma e fantascienza in una pellicola HBO. Un operaio di una centrale nucleare russa, gravemente malato a causa delle radiazioni, ruba del plutonio per venderlo al mercato nero.

programme.desc: Annette Bening e Bill Nighy in un film sulla separazione. Edward annuncia alla moglie Grace di voler divorziare dopo 30 anni di matrimonio. Una decisione che spiazza tutta la famiglia.

programme.desc: David Oyelowo in un emozionante dramma targato HBO. Sconvolto dall'esperienza in Iraq, un veterano di guerra sprofonda in una crisi mentre attende la visita di un vecchio compagno d'armi.

programme.title: Colette
programme.desc: Keira Knightley nel biopic sulla scrittrice Gabrielle Sidonie Colette. Protagonista della scena artistica nella Parigi della Belle Epoque, divenne un modello di emancipazione femminile.

programme.desc: Dal bestseller di John Boyne, la commovente storia dell'amicizia fra Bruno, figlio di un gerarca nazista, e il coetaneo ebreo Shmuel, prigioniero in un campo di concentramento.

programme.title: Cast Away
programme.desc: Golden Globe a Tom Hanks, in un'avventura diretta da Robert Zemeckis. In seguito a un disastro aereo, un manager naufraga su un'isola deserta dove inizia una vita solitaria e primitiva.

programme.title: Padri e figlie
programme.desc: Intenso dramma familiare di Gabriele Muccino con Russell Crowe e Amanda Seyfried. Katie affronta i traumi di un'infanzia difficile, vissuta con un padre affetto da disturbi psicofisici.

programme.desc: Colin Farrell nel film targato Sky Original, premiato al Sundance Festival. Nel futuro, i membri di una famiglia devono fare i conti con il malfunzionamento dell'androide che vive con loro.

programme.desc: Claudia Gerini nel biopic sulla giornalista Federica Angeli. La cronista de 'La Repubblica' indaga sulla criminalita' organizzata di Ostia. Le ritorsioni non tarderanno ad arrivare.

programme.title: Gli ultimi saranno ultimi
programme.desc: Dramma sociale di Massimiliano Bruno con Paola Cortellesi e Alessandro Gassmann. La vita di una donna, licenziata perche' incinta, si intreccia con quella di un poliziotto tormentato.

programme.desc: Rosamund Pike e Nick Nolte in un avvincente thriller psicologico. Vittima di una crudele aggressione, una meticolosa infermiera ordisce un diabolico piano di vendetta.

programme.title: La scandalosa vita di Bettie Page
programme.desc: Dalla regista di 'American Psycho', la biografia della nota pin up degli anni 50. Arrivata a New York con il sogno di fare l'attrice, Bettie (Gretchen Mol, interprete di "Boardwalk Empire") diventera' la prima famosa modella di bondage e l'icona della liberta' sessuale in un'America attratta dal proibito: per tutti, "The Pin-Up Queen of the Universe". Finira' per esser chiamata come testimone davanti al Senato degli Stati Uniti nell'inchiesta sugli effetti della visione di materiale pornografico sugli adolescenti americani.

programme.title: The Young Messiah

Almeno fino a quando, nella sua bottega, non scopre una vecchia risuolatrice: un vero e proprio cimelio, che gli permette di trasformarsi in ognuno dei suoi clienti semplicemente indossando le loro scarpe. Max ne approfittera' per dare un lustro piu' elettrizzante e avventuroso alla sua esistenza, assumendo varie identita' e andando incontro a momenti divertenti e imprevisti imbarazzanti.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 1: Denver Nuggets at Oklahoma City Thunder
programme.desc: Denver Nuggets at Oklahoma City Thunder in Game 1 of a Western Conference semifinal series. From Paycom Center. The top-seeded Thunder return to action after eight off days, facing interim coach David Adelman's Nuggets, who are fresh off winning a seven-game slugfest vs. the Clippers. MVP candidates Nikola Jokic and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander star in the teams first playoff meeting since 2011, when OKC got its first postseason series win since moving from Seattle.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 3: Oklahoma City Thunder at Denver Nuggets
programme.desc: Oklahoma City Thunder at Denver Nuggets in Game 3 of a Western Conference semifinal series. From Ball Arena. The series is knotted at 1-1 as top-seeded OKC rolls into the Mile High City for the first time since early November, following a resounding 149-106 win in Game 2. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander tallied 34 points in just 30 minutes, with his team scoring an NBA playoff record 87 first-half points.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 4: Oklahoma City Thunder at Denver Nuggets
programme.desc: Oklahoma City Thunder at Denver Nuggets in Game 4 of a Western Conference semifinal series. From Ball Arena. A battle-tested Nuggets squad won Game 3 in overtime to take a 2-1 series lead on green, top-seeded OKC. Jamal Murray (27 pts., 4 steals) and Aaron Gordon sparked Denver while big man Nikola Jokic struggled (0-for-10 on threes, 8 turnovers). Jalen Williams' 32 points paced the Thunder.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 5: Denver Nuggets at Oklahoma City Thunder
programme.desc: Denver Nuggets at Oklahoma City Thunder in Game 5 of a Western Conference semifinal series. From Paycom Center. Mark Daigneault's Thunder return home tied 2-2 as they've disrupted Denver big man Nikola Jokic into more turnovers (23) than assists (22) through four games. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander had nine of his 25 points late in a 92-87 Game 4 win, in which OKC also had a 35-8 edge in bench scoring.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 2: Detroit Pistons at New York Knicks
programme.desc: Detroit Pistons at New York Knicks in Game 2 of an Eastern Conference first-round series. From Madison Square Garden. The Pistons try again to end their 15-game playoff losing streak after falling 123-112 in Game 1 in the Big Apple, crumbling by 40-21 in the fourth quarter. Jalen Brunson's 34 led New York, while Karl-Anthony Towns and OG Anunoby combined for nine steals, four blocks and 46 points.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 3: New York Knicks at Detroit Pistons
programme.desc: New York Knicks at Detroit Pistons in Game 3 of an Eastern Conference first-round series. From Little Caesars Arena. J.B. Bickerstaff's Pistons return to the Motor City as playoff winners for the first time in 17 years following a 100-94 triumph in Game 2 that knotted the series at 1-1. Cade Cunningham piled up 33 points and 12 boards in the win, while Jalen Brunson's 37 went for naught.

programme.title: NBA Playoff

programme.desc: New York Knicks at Detroit Pistons in Game 4 of an Eastern Conference first-round series. From Little Caesars Arena. J.B. programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 5: Detroit Pistons at New York Knicks
programme.desc: Detroit Pistons at New York Knicks in Game 5 of an Eastern Conference first-round series. From Madison Square Garden. Jalen Brunson (32 points, 11 assists) and Karl-Anthony Towns (27 points) led the way in Game 4, which also saw a last-second non-call go New York's way on a three-point shot by Tim Hardaway Jr.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 2: New York Knicks at Boston Celtics
programme.desc: New York Knicks at Boston Celtics in Game 2 of an Eastern Conference semifinal series. From TD Garden. Tom Thibodeau's Knicks try to maintain the momentum of a gritty 108-105 overtime win in the opener in which they trailed Boston by 20 in the second half. OG Anunoby and Jalen Brunson scored a game-high 29 in the win, which snapped a nine-game home playoff win streak for the Celtics dating back to Game 2 of last spring's second round vs. Cleveland.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 2: Denver Nuggets at Oklahoma City Thunder
programme.desc: Denver Nuggets at Oklahoma City Thunder in Game 2 of a Western Conference semifinal series. From Paycom Center. Top-seeded OKC tries to bounce back from a demoralizing 121-119 loss to the Nuggets in Game 1, which the Thunder led for the entire second half until Aaron Gordon's three in the final seconds. Nikola Jokic amassed team-highs of 42 points, 22 boards, six assists and seven turnovers.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 3: Indiana Pacers at Milwaukee Bucks
programme.desc: Indiana Pacers at Milwaukee Bucks in Game 3 of an Eastern Conference first-round series. From Fiserv Forum. Doc Rivers' Bucks have work to do down 2-0 in this rematch from last year's first round, with six of the eight total meetings between the teams decided by double-digits. Indy never trailed in a 123-115 Game 2 win, sinking all 19 of its free throws as both sides shot well throughout.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 5: Milwaukee Bucks at Indiana Pacers
programme.desc: Milwaukee Bucks at Indiana Pacers in Game 5 of an Eastern Conference first-round series. From Gainbridge Fieldhouse. Indiana is a win away from its second straight first-round dispatching of the Bucks after scorching the nets with 60.2 percent shooting in a 129-103 Game 4 triumph. Myles Turner had 23 points (and four blocks) to lead eight double-figure scorers for the Pacers, who sank 18 threes.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 1: Los Angeles Clippers at Denver Nuggets
programme.desc: Los Angeles Clippers at Denver Nuggets in Game 1 of a Western Conference first-round series. From Ball Arena. Ty Lue's Clippers sail into the playoffs on an eight-game win streak, boasting the third-best FG pct. defense (39.5) in the league as they battle superstar Nikola Jokic, the third player ever to average a triple-double for an NBA season. Fellow Euro Ivica Zubac patrols the paint for L.A.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 2: Los Angeles Clippers at Denver Nuggets
programme.desc: Los Angeles Clippers at Denver Nuggets in Game 2 of a Western Conference first-round series. From Ball Arena. Denver's Russell Westbrook stung his previous Clippers mates with late clutch play in a 112-110 Game 1 overtime win. Nikola Jokic chipped in three of the Nuggets' 11 steals, to go with a game-high 29 points and 12 assists. James Harden's 32 points topped L.A., which blew a 15-point lead.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 4: Denver Nuggets at Los Angeles Clippers
programme.desc: Denver Nuggets at Los Angeles Clippers in Game 4 of a Western Conference first-round series. From Intuit Dome. L.A. is up 2-1 in a best-of-seven that began with two nail-biting finishes in Denver before the Clippers sailed to a 117-83 Game 3 win in their raucous new home in Inglewood. Nic Batum had four of L.A.'s 18 made three-pointers, to just seven for the Nuggets.

programme.title: CSI S5 E20 - Hollywood Brass
programme.desc: Some provocative episodes from Season 5 of CSI involve Russian mail order brides (\"Nesting Dolls\"), infantism (\"King Baby\"), and the Mexican lifestyle of narcocorrido (\"Snakes\"). From the creative storytelling (\"4x4\") to the macabre (\"Who Shot Sherlock?\"), there’s something in Season 5 for everyone. The CSI team investigates many crimes that hit close to home as well. Grissom comes under fire from Ecklie (\"Mea Culpa\"), Brass tracks down his estranged daughter (\"Hollywood Brass\"), and during the course of the season Greg Sanders completes his transition from the lab to the field. Last, but not least, Season 5 wraps with an amazing two-part episode (\"Grave Danger\"), written and directed by Quentin Tarantino, where Nick comes face to face with death while the team exhausts all its resources to same him.

bakery business legacy from closure. Now the

and innovations of the new generation?

loving son, and he aspires to become a lawyer for 
the underprivileged. After his mother was killed, he 
vowed to seek revenge against the influential 
retired judge, Benito Balmores.

programme.title: Minsan Pa Natin Hagkan ang Nakaraan ep 16
programme.desc: A woman who was severely broken by her greatest love finds love again in an older man who did everything to put her back together. programme.desc: On the way to school, Tomoya is almost hit by a girl on a scooter.

programme.sub-title: The Older and Younger Sister's Founder's Festival

programme.title: Clannad
programme.desc: Tomoya receives some shocking news about Fuko, who may never awaken from her coma; they fight to keep her memory alive at school.

programme.title: Clannad
programme.desc: Fuuko is starting to fade from everyone's memory; as Kouko's wedding comes up, no one remembers the meaning of the starfish.

programme.sub-title: Until the End of the Dream

programme.desc: Tomoya introduces Kotomi to Nagisa in hopes it will convince her to join the theater club; as Tomoya watches Kotomi and Nagisa speaking, he decides Kotomi needs more friends.

programme.title: Clannad
programme.desc: Tomoya falls asleep at school, only to awake to the sound of Kotomi playing the violin; a girl from the music room lent Kotomi the violin and wants everyone to hear her play.

programme.title: Clannad
programme.desc: Kyou tries to purchase a stuffed elephant for Kotomi's upcoming birthday; just as Kyou is about to give up, Fuuko appears and convinces her to give Kotomi a star instead.

programme.title: Clannad
programme.desc: Seeing Kotomi standing on newspaper clippings sparks Tomoya's childhood memories; Kotomi and Tomoya recall their childhood friendship, and Kotomi explores her feelings.

programme.title: Clannad
programme.desc: Tomoya falls asleep in the garden after working through the night; a mysterious stranger waits for Kotomi at school with the intention to steal her parents' thesis.

programme.title: Clannad
programme.desc: After she speaks with Toshio Koumura about becoming an adviser for their club, Nagisa receives a letter to stop the theater club.

programme.title: Clannad
programme.desc: When Nagisa, Tomoya, and Mei visit Sunohara, they find her dorm in shambles and no sign of Sunohara.

programme.title: Clannad
programme.desc: After a basketball game, the choir club approaches Nagisa about the prospect of sharing Moumura as a mutual adviser.

programme.title: Clannad
programme.desc: Tomoya is suspended from school, so he hangs out in his room all day thinking about Nagisa; in an attempt to make him feel better, Kyou and Ryou take him to the arcade.

programme.title: Clannad

programme.title: Clannad
programme.desc: Nagisa wants to put on a play about a girl and a robot; while looking through a storage shed for reference books about the play, Nagisa and Tomoya are confronted by Akio.

programme.desc: Akio has a video to show Nagisa and Tomoya; Nagisa who wants to put on a successful show.

programme.title: Clannad
programme.desc: The day of the festival has arrived; Nagisa is so upset about what happened to her dad that she breaks down.

programme.title: Clannad
programme.desc: Tomoya's and Nagisa's relationship is stagnant; Mei tries to help them by convincing Nagisa to open up her heart more to Tomoya.

programme.title: Clannad
programme.desc: An alternate ending reveals that Tomoya and Tomoyo have been together longer than anyone thought; rumors surface about the couple.

programme.desc: Fuko's sister gets invited to the Founders Festival; Fuko spreads the word about the upcoming wedding.

programme.desc: The police threaten to intervene if things don't improve between the two gangs.

programme.title: Clannad After Story
programme.desc: Graduation has arrived and everyone is discussing their plans.

programme.desc: Tomoyo wants to be independent so he takes a job at a bakery and gets his own place.

programme.title: Clannad After Story
programme.desc: Tomoya promises Nagisa that he will take her to the festival but ends up having to work late.

programme.title: Clannad After Story
programme.desc: Yusuke tells Tomoya about his past battles and losses; Tomoya is offered a job as a manager, but his father is taken into custody, causing the offer to fall away; Tomoya proposes to Nagisa.

programme.title: Clannad After Story
programme.desc: Tomoya tries to get Akio to consent to his marrying Nagisa but Akio says he'll talk only after Tomoya gets a hit in a ball game.

programme.title: Clannad After Story
programme.desc: Nagisa and Tomoya are starting their new lives together; Nagisa gets a job with Nishina in a restaurant; Tomoya gets upset when he discovers that the school building that used to house the drama club is being demolished.

programme.title: Clannad After Story
programme.desc: Morning sickness is keeping Nagisa bedridden; Sanae introduces her to a midwife, Yagi; Sanae confides to Tomoya her worries that having a child will be very hard for Nagisa, perhaps even hazardous.

programme.title: Clannad After Story
programme.desc: Nagisa becomes ill again and goes into premature labor; the snow storm prevents her from being rushed to the hospital.

programme.title: Clannad After Story
programme.desc: Tomoya has struggled with his heartache and Ushio is being brought up by Sanae and Akio; one day, Sanae visits Tomoya and convinces him to go on a family vacation with them.

programme.title: Clannad After Story
programme.desc: Tomoya buys Ushio a toy robot to play with. On their journey, the two walk through a flowery meadow and Ushio loses her toy in the grass.

programme.desc: After returning from their journey and going to see Sanae and Akio, Tomoya brings Ushio home to stay with him.

programme.title: Clannad After Story
programme.desc: Tomoya goes to Ushio's school to meet with her teacher and discoverd that it is Kyou; Kyou informs him that the school will be having a sports day and persuades him to partake.

programme.title: Clannad After Story
programme.desc: Ushio does not seem to be getting any better and Tomoya stays home with her.

programme.title: Clannad After Story
programme.desc: Sitting on the knoll, Tomoya calls out to Nagisa, who emerges and transports him back through time to see what their life could have been.

programme.title: Clannad After Story
programme.sub-title: The Event From One Year Before
programme.desc: Tomoya reflects on his past life and how everything began with a prank gone wrong altered his life in every aspect.

programme.title: Clannad After Story
programme.desc: Tomoya tells his daughter the tale of his life with Nagisa and how Ushio was born, but with a happier conclusion.

programme.title: Wonder Woman 1984
programme.desc: Wonder Woman battles Maxwell Lorenzano, an evil businessman, and Barbara Minerva, her friend-turned-foe, who wreak havoc on the world through a wish-granting artefact.

programme.title: The Hobbit: The Battle of the Five Armies
programme.desc: Bilbo Baggins, a hobbit, and the dwarves retrieve Lonely Mountain and its treasure. However, a fight breaks out between the dwarves, elves and men over it while Azog and his Orc army prepare for war.

programme.title: Let Me In
programme.desc: Owen leads a lonely life and is bullied by his peers at school. He happily befriends Abby, his new helpful neighbour, without being aware that she is hiding a secret from him.

programme.title: Stars!
programme.desc: The host sheds light on various popular individuals from different walks of life and highlights their individual journeys to stardom.

programme.title: The Gold Rush
programme.desc: During the Klondike Gold Rush, a lone prospector goes through a series of misfortunes, including a blizzard and starvation. However, he finds love even in the stormy Alaska.

programme.title: Non-Stop
programme.desc: A US air marshal receives threatening messages demanding that his airline transfer USD 150 million dollars to an offshore account, in the absence of which the passengers of his flight will be killed.

programme.title: Red Dawn
programme.desc: A soldier and his brother escape into the woods when their city is invaded by North Korean paratroopers. After their father is killed, the brothers form a guerrilla group to fight back.

programme.title: The Transporter Refueled
programme.desc: Frank Martin, a former mercenary, is hired by a woman and her accomplices to fulfil a contract. Soon, however, he must join forces with them to bring down a Russian crime lord.

programme.title: Superfast!
programme.desc: Undercover agent Lucas White endeavours to join Vin Serento's gang of street racers. Together, they plan to steal a large amount of money from crime kingpin Juan Carlos.

programme.title: Die Another Day
programme.desc: James Bond reaches the North Korean military base and finds out the presence of a corrupt colonel. However, his identity is revealed, and he strives to escape and reprimand the criminals.

programme.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II
programme.desc: John Rambo is offered the chance to cut short his prison tenure by going on a secret mission for the US government deep into the jungles of Vietnam and locating American POWs.

programme.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
programme.desc: When in a post-apocalyptic wasteland, Max, a wanderer, joins the rebel warrior Imperator Furiosa against his will in order to dethrone an autocrat who controls water supply to the land.

programme.title: Piranha 3DD
programme.desc: The bloodthirsty piranhas head towards a local water park. Amidst the fun-seeking horde at the park are friends Maddy, Barry and Kyle who decide to take on the man-eating creatures.

programme.title: No Time to Die
programme.desc: After leaving the active services, James Bond leads a peaceful life in Jamaica. However, a call for help from an old friend triggers a confrontation with a treacherous enemy.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: After their victory in the 74th Hunger Games, Katniss and Peeta must participate in the 75th Annual Hunger Games, featuring all its previous winners.
